name: KARTHIK BIBIREDDY
headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Distributed Platforms & Event Pipelines | Agentic Engineering Workflows
professionalSummary: Senior software engineer building distributed streaming and batch systems at Amazon and startups. Owns customer-facing platform programs that process hundreds of millions of events per day, including multi-region production migrations, microservices architecture, and team-wide agentic workflow adoption.

workExperience.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description: Sole technical owner of a zero-downtime, 3-region migration of customer-facing list-price streaming infrastructure (strikethrough and reference prices on product pages). Modernized CloudFormation to CDK, coordinated 8+ teams, and proved a shadow pipeline at 300M records/day and 99.9% parity before cutover. Reduced NAT egress 92% (470GB to 6GB/mo) with VPC endpoints, cut p99 latency 10 to 30ms, and saved $9-10K/month with no customer-facing downtime.

Designed a unified configuration platform for 9 production pricing systems, replacing fragmented rules spread across code, batch jobs, and config tables. Proposed a hybrid data plane plus control plane architecture so product managers can simulate rule changes, inspect live config with AI-assisted tooling, and ship changes through review and approval workflows; design approved for org-wide rollout.

Led post-incident analysis for a week-long pipeline failure that silently dropped all sales aggregation output, leaving stale and missing prices on customer-facing product pages (~406K products/day). Shipped row-count validation across 26 batch profiles, schema-change guardrails, and cross-org escalation playbooks with the audit team to catch systemic pricing failures earlier.

Led team AI adoption by building agentic workflows on a shared knowledge base indexed from runbooks, code, and operational docs. Shipped an on-call investigation agent, a customer-facing support chatbot that explains pricing logic with business and code context, and a ticket classifier with 75% adoption in support teams for early detection of rising incident patterns.

Built and scaled distributed pricing pipelines (Spark/EMR/Scala) supporting 300M+ global products, continuously adapting computation logic to evolving business rules, regional regulations, and compliance constraints.
Engineered high-performance automotive messaging services (C++ middleware + React Native integration) for real-time Bluetooth/Alexa voice and SMS delivery on Amazon automotive platforms.

Led integration of Alexa Teachable AI for conversational car-control personalization (for example, mapping custom phrases like 'cozy' to climate actions), launching successfully with Lamborghini and Rivian before broader rollout.
Built a low-latency Automotive Prompting Service in Java/RPC to enrich dialog responses with contextual suggestions, reducing Alexa Car Control abandonment by 15%.

workExperience.title: Software Engineer
description: Architected and deployed computer vision services for real-time face tracking and AR virtual try-on across web and mobile experiences.
Led WebAssembly performance optimization initiatives, improving latency and rendering smoothness through precision tuning and memory efficiency work.
Worked across TypeScript frontend and C++ inference layers to optimize integration boundaries, data flow, and runtime stability in browser environments.
Maintained and scaled cloud infrastructure with containerized deployments, monitoring, and CI/CD practices to improve reliability and release consistency.
Collaborated directly with enterprise customers to deliver production-grade integrations for reliable inference workloads.

workExperience.title: Software Engineer
description: Developed aerospace ground-control software with 3D geolocation mapping and real-time aircraft tracking, enabling low-latency telemetry visualization.
Built a Primary Flight Display using JavaScript/Node.js, broadcasting drone telemetry over UDP for real-time monitoring and operator decision support.
Implemented critical airliner systems components (Landing Gear software, Video Controller, Vehicle State Manager) to improve reliability and maintainability.
Ensured C++ flight software on NASA Core Flight Systems met standards for fault tolerance, redundancy, and real-time operation.
Improved quality through peer reviews, automated test coverage, and field validation during flight trials.

workExperience.title: Software Developer Intern
description: Built an NLP-powered news aggregation widget using topic modeling and keyword extraction for McDermott's corporate homepage.
Developed enterprise-facing NLP applications for finance and energy customers.
Supported large-scale ingestion pipelines processing millions of global data sources for enterprise analytics.

projects.title: Technical Analysis Platform for Financial Markets
description: Building a personal platform to backtest and analyze trading strategies using historical financial data, with event-driven AWS Lambda workflows, ETL pipelines for sentiment and technical analysis, and a React-based dashboard for strategy evaluation and performance tracking.

projects.title: Real Estate Investment Analysis Tool
description: Developed a web-based tool to evaluate real estate investment opportunities by comparing buying vs renting, incorporating inputs like purchase price, interest rate, taxes, and ownership costs to output projected ROI, breakeven points, and overall investment value in a clean, user-friendly interface.

projects.title: Closed Captioner iOS App
description: Built an accessibility-focused speech-to-text captioning app delivering real-time captions with emoji sentiment cues and local history management.
